title: Freelance Senior Data Engineer
description: Back to jobs New Freelance Senior Data Engineer Colombia Apply Location: This position is remote within Colombia Freelance Senior Data Engineer About technology At Huge, it’s not only about depth in technology, but ongoing incubation and experimentation as to how to apply technology. Every technologist at Huge helps bring ideas to reality. Job description We are seeking a Freelance Senior Data Engineer with strong expertise in digital analytics and web data collection to join our team. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience implementing and optimizing analytics solutions while ensuring accurate, scalable, and reliable data collection across digital platforms. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, validate, and improve analytics implementations that support business insights and data-driven decision-making. Important considerations This is a fully remote freelance contract opportunity. Start Date: August 19, 2026 End Date: November 13, 2026 Equipment: You will use your own computer and equipment. Engagement Type: independent contractor What you'll be doing Implement, configure, and maintain Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Tag Manager (GTM) solutions. Design and optimize event tracking strategies and digital measurement frameworks. Validate, troubleshoot, and maintain analytics implementations to ensure data accuracy and consistency. Collaborate with engineering, product, and analytics teams to define tracking requirements and measurement solutions. Support debugging and tag implementation using JavaScript when needed. Identify opportunities to improve data quality, tracking performance, and reporting capabilities. Participate in Agile ceremonies and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. What we would like to see Strong hands-on experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Tag Manager (GTM). Experience implementing, maintaining, and troubleshooting web analytics and tagging solutions. Solid understanding of event tracking, digital measurement, and data collection strategies. Experience validating and optimizing analytics implementations across web applications. Familiarity with JavaScript for tag implementation, debugging, and troubleshooting. Experience working in Agile environments with cross-functional teams. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Professional English proficiency with excellent verbal and written communication skills. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or 6+ years of equivalent professional experience. If the selected candidate holds a degree in Engineering or a related profession, they must present their professional license.
